cases.title: Install and establish the article library foreground
steps: Launch EntryAbility on an unlocked device
assertions: ZhuoBrowser, not another app, is foreground and interactive

cases.title: Save the original live WeChat URL
steps: Choose Save Article in the external-open dialog
assertions: Correct title replaces the failed row without duplication
Saved status and readable text/images are visible

cases.title: Reopen saved content with WLAN and mobile data disabled
steps: Hardware back to library and reopen
assertions: Both original network toggles are restored

cases.title: Save from browser menu, reader mode and pasted URL
steps: Save the same article through each entry
Paste a URL in the library and explicitly submit
Repeat in compact portrait and landscape with keyboard

cases.title: Reproduce the reported live WeChat article
steps: Save and compare beginning, middle, ending and images against source
assertions: Complete versus partial status is accurate

cases.title: Failure feedback, retry and legacy content preservation
steps: Retry an existing saved article with network unavailable
Open a library created by the prior version
assertions: Old readable content and notes survive failed updates

cases.title: Offline relaunch, rendering and reading offset
steps: Save a page with images and scroll halfway
assertions: Text and saved images render without requests
Missing images are not represented as a complete save

cases.title: Selection, annotations and filters
steps: Select text across inline formatting and highlight
assertions: Filters and search reflect stored state

cases.title: System-picker HTML and Markdown export
steps: Open exported HTML with network off

cases.title: Expired Pro preserves access to existing data
steps: Use a legitimate expired/non-Pro entitlement fixture with existing articles
Try adding and updating an article
assertions: New saves and retries require Pro
